text:
Anita: Morning all — async standup: Yesterday I finished the core spec for 'routing fallback' and uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/route-fallback. Blocker: still need decisions on canary quota + rollout window. Today: update PR for the spec, sync with Tom on infra limits. Ping @Devin for perf numbers.
Devin: Got perf numbers — qps looks OK on staging for 2k concurrent sessions, but tail p99 spikes when kv-cache miss rate > 20%. Sharing chart: https://metrics.redwood/staging/route-fallback. I'd recommend limiting initial canary to 50rps per region.
Tom: WIP on infra side — branch `feat/route-fallback` has autoscaler tweaks, awaiting review. CI failing on one integration test (`cache_reconnect_test`) — looking into flakiness. ETA EOD.
Maria: UX note: fallback copy should read "Switching to reduced model for reliability" — @Anita we can mock in the demo. Also need a short microcopy for the banner.
Anita: Thanks. For canary decisions: propose 5% traffic, 1 region, 1-day ramp, manual rollback. Agree? @Sharon @Devin
Sharon: Works for SRE. I'll reserve capacity and set alert for p95 latency + error rate. Can you add a healthcheck endpoint (simple `/healthz`) on the canary?
Andy: QA will run the prompt regression suite against the canary branch; need the test harness URL and creds. @Tom please share test token.
Tom: Sending token in 1:1, not in channel. CI fix: re-ran the flaky test, looks like race with KV client connect; I'll add tiny backoff.
Deploy-bot: Preview build ready: https://deploys.internal/preview/1945678901 — contains spec doc link and demo. Status: ✅ all unit tests, ⏳ integration pending.
Devin: :thumbsup: Agree to 5%/1-day ramp. One ask: set CPU throttling to avoid noisy neighbors — add `cpu.shares: 512` on canary pods.
Anita: Great. Action items: (1) Tom fix CI + add healthcheck (2) Sharon reserve capacity & alerting (3) Devin adjust canary qps + cpu config (4) Andy run regression on canary (5) Maria supply banner copy. I'll update the spec and ship the rollout doc. Ping here if anything blocks.
Andy: I'll schedule regression for 11am PT and post results here.
Maria: Banner copy draft: 'We're temporarily using a reliability-optimized mode to keep responses fast. Learn more.' Putting in Figma.
Anita: Nice. If no objections by EOD I'll lock rollout plan. Thanks team :rocket:
